description: Preserved on the base; former registration F-THAJ. Mirage IV disposal list compiled by 'BEN' on the Delta Reflex forum (December 2023), which tracks all 62 Mirage IVA/IVP airframes individually.

Magister that stood on a plinth on the base for 24 years. Taken down on 20 April 2026 by base personnel and CAEA volunteers for refurbishment and due to return to the plinth. Some sources give the base the number 204 rather than 106. Reported by the French preservation blog foxalphazoulou.overblog.com in its monthly 'Infos patrimoine' updates (2026).
